title: Reconcile verified data and governance work into local main

skills.purpose: Classify governance and evidence artifacts before integration.

acceptance.text: Every current dirty path is classified from direct evidence and no unknown path is staged.
Classification authority references and posture counts remain internally hash-consistent.
Governance manager changes pass focused regressions without weakening fail-closed controls.
Verified deliverables are committed on local main in coherent commits, with no push, training, GPU, media regeneration, or data mutation.

risks: Do not stage or delete an artifact whose provenance or retention status is unknown.
Do not alter reviewed labels, split authorities, temporal semantics, or upstream data.
Do not push to origin without a separate explicit request.
non_actions: No video decode, detection, tracking, crop regeneration, spatial re-extraction, GPU, or training.
No raw-data, review, split, or source-authority mutation.
No reset, clean, stash, or deletion of pre-existing user-owned work.

steps.summary: Audit every uncommitted path and verify its authority, provenance, and required retention.
Run focused governance and authority validation for the selected candidates.
Commit only verified current deliverables to local main in coherent scope-separated commits.
Review integration outcome, preserve any excluded paths, and close the governed reconciliation task.
